# Feature Request

Provide a clear and concise description of the requested feature.

- **Summary**: (One-line summary)
- **Motivation**: Why is this needed? What problem does it solve?
- **Use Cases**: Describe specific use cases or examples.
- **Proposed solution**: Outline how the feature could work (high-level).
- **Alternatives considered**: Other approaches that were evaluated.
- **Drawbacks**: Any potential downsides.
- **Implementation notes (optional)**: Files/areas likely affected.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Describe when this request can be considered complete.

## Checklist
- [ ] Performed a search for existing issues/PRs
- [ ] Added tests if applicable
- [ ] Updated documentation if applicable
